scope: User requested publication of three journal/article credit programs and inclusion in existing daily research task.

added_listings.title: ASATT Sensor: EEG Monitoring Article and Quiz
added_listings.description: The Summer 2025 EEG monitoring article by Elizabeth Fumicello, Cer. A.T.T., and Nelson J. Aquino, DNP, MS, CRNA, FAANA includes a quiz awarding 1 ASATT continuing education credit with an 80% passing score. Published quiz fees are $10 for members and $20 for nonmembers; reading the PDF is free. This is anesthesia technologist credit, not verified ASET credit. Confirm ABRET eligibility, current processing terms and expiration before purchasing.
added_listings.badge: 1 ASATT credit · Paid quiz · Verify EEG eligibility
added_listings.accessRequirement: Free article PDF; paid quiz, $10 member / $20 nonmember

added_listings.title: Neurology Journal Article CME
added_listings.description: American Academy of Neurology journal articles have companion quizzes offering up to 0.75 AMA PRA Category 1 Credit per designated quiz. Current topics include epilepsy and status epilepticus. Read the designated article and complete its quiz and evaluation through AAN Online Learning using an AAN membership login. Confirm actual access fees, activity expiration, nonphysician eligibility and ABRET applicability. These are physician CME activities, not verified ASET CEUs.
added_listings.badge: 0.75 physician CME per quiz · Verify EEG eligibility
added_listings.accessRequirement: AAN membership login; specific fees and nonphysician eligibility require confirmation
added_listings.creditEligibility: AMA physician CME; EEG technologist and ABRET applicability unverified

added_listings.title: IQCB Continuing Education Articles
added_listings.description: The International QEEG Certification Board offers existing IQCB certified Diplomates and Technologists free article questionnaires worth 1 CE hour each, with a maximum of 5 articles per year toward QEEG recertification. Certificant login is required. This is a restricted certification benefit, not a generally available free membership. Individual article dates are behind login. ABRET acceptance and ASET approval have not been verified.
added_listings.badge: IQCB certificants only · Verify ABRET eligibility
added_listings.accessRequirement: Existing IQCB certified Diplomate or Technologist login; not general free membership
added_listings.creditEligibility: IQCB QEEG recertification; ABRET applicability unverified
